fields.Name: T329 - Bulk Operations App Load
fields.Description: Exercises the BulkOperationsContainer left-nav shell + the BulkOperationsOperations resource component load path (BaseResourceComponent → hosted RecordProcessStudioComponent), distinct from any generic entity grid or dashboard load.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (top-left) and choose 'Bulk Operations' (layer-group icon). The app should open into a left-nav shell titled 'Bulk Operations' with two sections in the rail — 'Operations' and 'Run History' — and the Operations section should be selected, showing either a table of bulk operations (columns Operation / Entity / Type / Status / Actions) or a 'No bulk operations yet' empty state with a 'Create one' button. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the shell with both nav sections and the Operations studio content render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Bulk Operations app opens with a left-nav shell exposing both an 'Operations' and a 'Run History' section
The Operations section renders the studio content — either a bulk-operations table or the 'No bulk operations yet' empty state (either is a pass)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
